Sam: quick sync 1 — can we adopt a VERY small claim flow for SI co-sell on marketplace bundles? Pilot only. @Priya @Ethan-SI :wave:
Priya: yes. Keep minimal: 3bd claim TTL, extend to 7bd if SI sets tech_ownership=true. One canonical CSV and a single weekly adjudication slot (Fri 11am PT).
Ethan-SI: SI ask: if we delivered a POC repo or milestone ticket, that should bump priority automatically. We'll supply repo link + demo recording.
Marta: marketing/legal: marketplace publish freeze = 5bd before go-live. Legal needs 72h on logos. Add `marketplace_ready` flag in the manifest.
Sam: CSV headers (compact):
```
account_id,account_name,region,owner_sales,owner_si,claim_ts,claim_ttl_days,tech_ownership,proof_url,marketplace_ready,confidence_pct,slack_thread_url
```
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "si-brief-dedupe" nightly 04:00 UTC. Report: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-brief/2900001111 :robot_face:
Priya: adjudication rules (pilot): 1) if confidence_pct>85 auto-resolve, 2) tech_ownership=true extends TTL and trumps simple first-claim, 3) otherwise first-claim wins. Escalate to triage within 48h.
Ethan-SI: will add sample repo + demo link to the template. Also want CRM sync id column if possible.
Marta: will add a short marketing checklist and markups for the marketplace blurb.
Sam: action items: Priya post CSV + two sample rows today, ops-bot post first dedupe tomorrow, pilot window 2 weeks. Thanks all — small, fast trial to reduce churn. :pray:
